rv.q: A gripping and superb new production of "Topdog/Underdog" opened Thursday at The Old Globe, under the taut and intricately detailed direction of Steve H. Broadnax III, and starring the talented and charismatic actors Alano Miller and Elijah Jones.
More than two decades after its premiere, Topdog/Underdog retains every bit of its original bite.
Miller and Jones do an exceptional job as the close but often feuding brothers.
